package repository

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"time"
)

// DiagnosticPlanningRepository looks up the exact diagnostic INITIAL identity.
type DiagnosticPlanningRepository interface {
	GetDiagnosticPlanningRequest(context.Context, string, string) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error)
}

type DiagnosticInitialAllocationRepository interface {
	GetInitialAllocation(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint, error)
	CheckpointInitialAllocation(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest, domain.InitialAllocationCheckpoint, time.Time) error
	ResumeDiagnosticPlanning(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error)
}
